title: Asymptotic values of solutions to a periodic linear difference equation modeling discrimination training
summary: This work is concerned with the study of $w(mT)$ as $m$ goes to infinity, where $w(t)$ evolves according to $w(t)-w(t-1)=F(t)-A(t)w(t-1)$, and where $T$ is the period of the vector $F(t)$ and the matrix $A(t)$. Motivated by applications to associative learning, particularly to discrimination training, extra conditions are imposed on $F(t)$ and $A(t)$, one of them relating $A(t)$ to a symmetric non-negative definite matrix $K$ relevant to mathematical models of associative learning.
